captions.detailed: A long telephoto zoom lens featuring a dark matte cylindrical barrel with an outer zoom ring, an inner focus ring, and a wider-diameter front element housing at the tip. A rotating tripod collar ring with a flat locking lever clamp is mounted around the midpoint of the barrel. At the rear, a metallic grey mount plate is detailed with a small red alignment dot and a tiny locking pin.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a telephoto camera zoom lens with an outer zoom ring, an inner focus ring, a rotating tripod collar ring with a flat locking lever, a wider front element housing, and a metallic rear mount plate featuring an alignment dot and locking pin.
captions.factory: Construct the main lens barrel using cylindrical primitives of varying diameters. Form the ribbed zoom and focus rings by subtracting or patterning small grooves along the cylinder surfaces. Create the tripod collar by adding a larger ring around the midpoint, combined with a flat box primitive representing the locking lever. Finally, attach a metallic-colored disk at the rear for the mount plate, detailing it with a small colored sphere for the alignment dot and a tiny pin cylinder.
